text: What Isaac knows is never told. He carries the wood; he asks about the lamb; and the answer his father gives him leaves the question where it was. Of his mind the narrator offers nothing, only a verb: they went, both of them, together. The phrase recurs, and the repetition is made to serve in place of explanation. The question of consent is raised, and then quietly set down unresolved. Obedience, in this account, settles everything and leaves no remainder.
